title: Familiar Buffs
description: Adds buffs to horses, donkeys, mules, skeleton horses and happy ghast.
body:
Added:\
Spur: Press [Sprint] while on a horse.\
Boost: Press [Sprint] while on a happy ghast.

Changes (horses/donkeys/mules):\
Their new max health a solid 20 Hearts.\
This doesn't affect breeding\
They're now 10% smaller so you can see over their heads and fight mobs easier.\
The slab tricks for stables still work
